submission_identity.repository_head_rule: Submit the exact final merged V2 main commit SHA externally. V1 remains immutable.

revision_v2.job_publication_rule: same verified company-owned site; job/career detail URL; specific title; job-detail marker; explicit apply/application action
revision_v2.company_update_publication_rule: same verified company-owned site; news/blog/press detail URL; specific title; explicit publication date

canonical_audit.source: immutable certified V1 1000-company output; repository-derived after inactive-role safety filter
canonical_audit.note: This immutable-corpus audit projects the committed V1 output envelope only; live V2 runs additionally recover exact-org registry fields from retained V1 profiles through v2_registry_projection.

fresh_validation.purpose: fresh engineering diagnostic for V2 canonical/product/activity behavior; not an official Builderr score
fresh_validation.overlap_scope: zero overlap is proven against the repository's 5900 prior internal cohorts plus the immutable certified V1 1000; Builderr's private 700-company capture is unknown and not claimed disjoint
fresh_validation.interpretation: V2 materially improves explicit canonical exposure and product linkage. The bounded retained-page crawl did not yield any facts meeting the strict job/update publication gates on this fresh 300, so no job/news coverage improvement is claimed.

runtime.ocr_failure_policy: abstain; do not invent a workforce value

source_classes.name: Brønnøysundregistrene open data and official account copies
source_classes.role: entity identity, registry facts, roles, group structure, locations, financials and workforce evidence
source_classes.license_or_rights_basis: NLOD 2.0 for BRREG open-data datasets; official annual-account copies are fetched only to extract bounded claim evidence/hash metadata

source_classes.name: Wikidata structured data
source_classes.role: exact Norwegian organisation-number to official-website candidate nomination only
source_classes.publication_boundary: candidate only; independent company-page identity proof is required before website publication

source_classes.name: Verified company-owned public web pages
source_classes.role: website identity proof and bounded description/contact/social-link/job/update evidence
source_classes.acquisition: bounded public HTTP retrieval with safe URL/redirect handling
source_classes.license_or_rights_basis: No blanket content-reuse licence is assumed; retain provenance and bounded factual spans rather than republishing pages
source_classes.publication_boundary: only exact-company evidence is published; generic careers/news indexes, cross-domain pages and ambiguous/conflicting pages abstain

explicit_non_sources: No independent sentiment model in the production runner
No generic careers-page inference as hiring
No generic news-index inference as company activity
No inferred follower counts, engagement or platform verification
known_limitations: Builderr owns the reference collection, matching logic, availability denominator and official score; this repository does not claim that hidden recall, coverage or total-score gates are proven.
Verified company websites, social declarations and contact emails are intentionally conservative because publication requires exact-entity evidence.

The fresh V2 300-company diagnostic produced zero strict job-posting facts and zero strict dated company-update facts; no job/news coverage improvement is claimed from this bounded retained-page layer.
Annual-report workforce extraction abstains on missing or conflicting company-scope employee/FTE phrases.
A company-declared social URL means only that the exact verified company page declared that URL; the platform page itself is not fetched.
A published contact email means the address was present in retained first-party evidence and matched the verified website registered domain; mailbox deliverability is not claimed.
V2 canonical-audit and fresh-validation counts are engineering diagnostics, not an official Builderr evaluation.
